title: Enterprise Connectivity: separate statutory tax qualifying scope
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following eligibility and object boundaries for separate statutory tax.

## Scope clause 15
For separate statutory tax, this assisted route applies only to the uniquely identified unbilled source bundle whose interval tier matches the current holding tier and whose contract is on-demand with no approved negotiated rate.

## Scope clause 16
For separate statutory tax, its latest invoice assessment names that source bundle explicitly.

## Scope clause 17
For separate statutory tax, this invoice route requires selected export bundle to be the sole posted primary internet outbound transfer meter for its holding and UTC month, representing the entire month with the holding active throughout it; the full monthly allowance therefore belongs to that source.

## Scope clause 18
For separate statutory tax, its tier, commercial attributes, US East region and approved tax treatment must match the unchanged current holding attributes.

## Scope clause 19
For separate statutory tax, other monthly sources retain ordinary chronological allocation and are outside this assisted route.
